'''Arrowhead Command''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] responsible for security in the [[Arrowhead]], the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It was commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]] from the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Whirlwind (Imperial-class)|''Whirlwind'']].<ref name="SWG:TLR">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
